observed: Prepare-phase Wave Council PASS (moderator: council-chair; primer-depth: standard; seats: red-team, docs-contract-reviewer; rotating-seat: docs-contract-reviewer). Red-team primer and closing: no unresolved challenges. Docs reviewed public carriers and rejected stale baseline examples. 23rgx establishes first useful outcome and post-delivery measurement on author exercise; 23s4d establishes navigable stages on fresh reader and disposable routing probes; Objective establishes on these examples. Falsification: memorized examples could pass a superficial test, so use paraphrases, actual output and side effects. README-only misses downstream routing. First human onboarding remains unobserved. Same model-family, chair knew seats; no blinded synthesis claim.
proposition: council-readiness approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.

Both Product Intent carriers preserve the approved guidance; the walkthrough demonstrates an explicit delivery review against HTTP 200, and both routing carriers keep definition and engineering on one draft. Only turns 1/3/4 wrote. Customized catalog retained local terms and preserved its other content. Both changes and objective demonstrated in exercised cases. No field/cross-host or install claim.
